claim_en: THE FAT BAN'S SCOPE: Israel is exhorted against the forbidden fat — NOT the sons of Noah: the a-fortiori from the limb-of-the-living (which does bind them) is refuted by 'the children of Israel' — a recorded NEGATIVE boundary of the Noahide set. Proselytes and freed slaves included; unclean species excluded; hybrids included; and the doubtful class (the koi) with the sub-olive quantum sit inside the EXHORTATION though outside the punishment — the ban is wider than its karet.

THE SCOPING INVERSION: The carrion-fat of the CLEAN beast is distinct from its flesh — free of carrion-tumah and usable for all work — while the clean wild animal's fat, permitted as food, is excluded from the exemption: prohibition and tumah-exemption trade places, sealed by the ink. Feeding it onward is permitted; even the benefit-forbidden carcasses (the stoned ox, the broken-neck heifer) stay tumah-clean by the doubled fat-word; and 'for all service' answers both recorded mirror-doubts — consecrated and mundane use alike.

THE KARET CRITERION: The fat-karet covers blemished and mundane animals — but only the TYPE of fat that stands to be sacrificed (Exod 29:13's list): the chest-wall fat is out. The karet template runs its five clauses: the soul not the congregation, the DRINKER included (dissolved fat), the forcer excluded, an olive-size, the people at peace — the same frame as the rejection and tumah seats.

THE BLOOD BAN'S SPECIES TEST: 'Of bird and of beast' supplies the criteria — dual-grade tumah, a prohibition-then-permission life cycle through slaughter, the meat class — EXCLUDING the blood of men, reptiles, eggs, grasshoppers, and fish; the karet blood is the lifeblood; in all your habitations.

source: Onkelos Leviticus 7:30; Sifra, Tzav, Chapter 16; Sifra, Tzav, Section 11
claim_en: THE WAVING ENGINE: Israel waves — not gentiles (argued through the recorded greater-measure comparison with hand-laying), the sons not the daughters, proselytes and freed slaves in; THE STACKED HANDS: the priest's hands under the owner's, waving together. The exclusion cascade: slaughtered offerings only (birds and meal-offerings out), not firstborn, tithe, or Pesach, not sin- or guilt-offerings — the leper's living-waved ram the recorded counterexample that makes the verse necessary — with the communal peace-offerings included.
